name: Camp Wurg
summary: Dustbelcher ogres hold Camp Wurg among the Badlands crags. Their camps reach across much of the harsh region.

sections.title: A Dustbelcher Stronghold
sections.body: Dustbelcher ogres guard Camp Wurg among the Badlands crags. It is one of their four main camps, with Camp Cagg, Camp Boff, and Camp Kosh. The ogres scavenge across the desert wastes and defend their rugged territory fiercely. Brutes and enforcers gather around crude fires and rough hides. Boss Tho'grun, their chieftain, has no permanent seat at Wurg. He roams the Badlands trails and watches over all four camps.

faq.answer: Dustbelcher ogres live at Camp Wurg, one of their settlements across the Badlands.

faq.q: Where is the leader of the camp?
faq.answer: Boss Tho'grun, chieftain of the Dustbelcher ogres, roams the Badlands trails between Camp Wurg, Camp Cagg, Camp Boff, and Camp Kosh.

faq.q: What other camps belong to this tribe?
faq.answer: The Dustbelcher ogres hold four main camps in the Badlands: Camp Wurg, Camp Cagg, Camp Boff, and Camp Kosh.
